provenance: Studio-profile thresholds, chosen 2026-08-19 against measured guard scores on a real recording processed by the studio core (StudioVoiceCore/DFN3): good restoration output measured mean_js 0.13-0.14, peak_js 0.63-0.68, envelope_correlation 0.99, consonant_retention 0.90-0.92, spectral_hole 0.02, musical_noise 0.07-0.08. Bounds are set roughly 2x the measured good-output values. The studio profile runs the guard in 'integrity' mode: spectral identity is NOT enforced (restoration changes the spectrum by design); timing, envelope, artifact, and collapse protections remain enforced. 2026-08-19 revision: spectral_hole_thresh rescaled to 0.10 after the detector was changed to score only active frames and signal bins (measured false-reject on a DJI field recording: clean denoise scored 0.66 under the old all-frames metric, 0.00 under the new one).
